bugEvidence: Before the fix, stop let a pending readiness result trigger another reservation. Wait could run a late job. Release or expire let a late result reach cancellation at the invocation gate, and release had already taken its local lease snapshot. The fixed cycle checks admission after asynchronous gates and handles late reservations according to the shutdown policy.

A reclaimed token remained locally owned and its handler was not canceled. Renewal now checks returned token references, invalidates only the stale reservation, cancels the affected invocation and drops its result. Explicit batch yields are retained for owned jobs and unfinished owned peers are deferred without charging an attempt. A committed progressive ACK cannot cancel its still-running peers while the response is delayed.

A failed acknowledgement ended release-mode shutdown while the peer deferral was still pending. Shutdown now drains both buffers, attempts to return remaining leases and preserves transition failures.
